source_definition: An analytical clause-level obligation candidate decomposed from an official SbD requirement.
target_definition: A candidate atomic semantic obligation decomposed from one official compound SORA requirement.

source_definition: Information technology considered in programme cyber-risk assessment.
target_definition: An information-technology system used by an applicant/operator or supporting organisation.

source_definition: Define and assign cybersecurity roles, responsibilities and accountabilities.
target_definition: A policy addressing cyber-safety governance, roles, responsibilities, or practices.

source_definition: An information artefact used in procurement or contracting.
target_definition: A documentary information artefact used to define, support, or evidence SORA compliance.

source_definition: A record or documented evidence item showing that an assurance-relevant activity, event or review occurred.
target_definition: A retained record of an activity, status, qualification, maintenance action, or other assurance-relevant fact.

source_definition: An external service or support arrangement that augments internal recovery capability.
target_definition: A service external to the UAS/operator that supports the operation and may require assurance.

source_definition: A documented statement defining organisational or Defence risk appetite.
target_definition: A policy defining organisational expectations, controls, or responsibilities.

source_definition: The programme framework into which vulnerability and broader cyber-risk management are integrated.
target_definition: A programme integrating relevant safety and security risk management activities.

source_definition: An official source criterion/evidence-area used to organise SbD requirements.
target_definition: A criterion grouping within an OSO under which requirement clauses are organised.

source_definition: An official MOD Secure by Design principle grouping related criteria and requirements.
target_definition: A SORA Operational Safety Objective (OSO) to which criteria and requirements are allocated.

source_definition: A programme, person, organisation, role, group or network involved in SbD governance or delivery.
target_definition: A person or organisation that can participate in, be responsible for, or provide services relevant to SORA assurance.

source_definition: Documented information used to demonstrate or support fulfilment of an SbD requirement.
target_definition: A Functional Hazard Assessment used to demonstrate system-safety assurance.

source_definition: Define security requirements from risk and incorporate them into programme or procurement artefacts.
target_definition: A controlled classification distinguishing Annex E safety requirements from Cyber Extension cyber-safety/security requirements.

source_definition: An abstract management concept used to govern cybersecurity decisions, risk, controls or awareness.
target_definition: An abstract cybersecurity or safety concept referenced by the SORA requirement set.

source_definition: Knowledge required to support programme or operational activity.
target_definition: A procedure governing normal, contingency, emergency, inspection, or other operational activity.

source_definition: A function performed by or supported by a capability.
target_definition: A cybersecurity function or process such as authentication or authorisation.

source_definition: An adverse cybersecurity event affecting a capability, system, data or essential function.
target_definition: A controlled type of security event or indicator, such as anomaly, suspicious activity, malicious activity, or security breach.

source_definition: A documented cybersecurity strategy, plan, assessment, inventory or other structured security artefact.
target_definition: A documented result or artefact produced by an assessment or appraisal.

source_definition: CADMID Manufacture stage; used where component/design/manufacturing applicability is plausible.
target_definition: A material used in manufacture or maintenance of the UAS.

source_definition: A protected and tested copy or recovery resource used to support continuity or recovery.
target_definition: A recognised accreditation used to support assurance.

source_definition: An activity used to manage assets, people and security through capability life.
target_definition: A fatigue risk management system used to manage escalation in duty/flight-duty times.

source_definition: A direct reference or link to a named programme assurance artefact.
target_definition: A controlled classification for a criterion, such as Integrity, Assurance, or Applicability/Cross-reference.

source_definition: An entity participating in organisational security activity.
target_definition: An electronic or written log file containing recorded UAS or security activity.

source_definition: Maintain through-life management of programme assets in line with policy.
target_definition: An organisational structure, management system, programme, or culture established to satisfy SORA requirements.

source_definition: CADMID In-Service stage; used where operation, monitoring, incidents, backups, reporting or recovery indicate in-service relevance.
target_definition: A service-level agreement or comparable commitment defining relevant service responsibilities or quality.

source_definition: A concept describing the selected response or treatment of identified risk.
target_definition: The documented concept of operations describing the proposed operation.

source_definition: Establish and maintain understanding of relevant mission, organisational, operational, data or risk context.
target_definition: A data communications link, which may be operational, safety-related, or payload-related depending on context.

source_definition: Design capability components, support and resourcing with cyber resilience considered.
target_definition: Firmware used within UAS or support components.

source_definition: The network of supplier organisations involved in providing capabilities, systems, services or support.
target_definition: Software used by the UAS, ground systems, maintenance systems, or supporting services.

source_definition: Perform cybersecurity planning and due diligence before contracting with a supplier.
target_definition: A checklist used to perform or evidence defined operational or assurance steps.

source_definition: Conduct structured two-way communication of cybersecurity risks across organisational and supply-chain boundaries.
target_definition: A command, control, and communication link required for safety of flight.

source_definition: A dependency on a single role or resource whose loss could undermine recovery capability.
target_definition: A failure of the UAS or supporting system relevant to safety or assurance.

source_definition: Identify and document data relevant to programme functioning or threat exposure.
target_definition: A controlled SORA source document from which requirements and provenance are derived.

source_definition: Provide, maintain or demonstrate role-relevant security, disposal, response or recovery training.
target_definition: A log of UAS activities and relevant security events used for subsequent analysis.

source_definition: A method or technique by which a threat actor could attack or analyse a system.
target_definition: A declaration made by an applicant/operator as a permitted assurance method at lower assurance levels.

source_definition: An organisational statement that informs the programme risk appetite.
target_definition: A formal assertion or statement concerning satisfaction, integrity, assurance, or another SORA-relevant condition.

source_definition: Clear assignment of responsibility for cybersecurity and risk decisions.
target_definition: The SORA Low, Medium, or High robustness level used in OSO requirement assignment. Not Required (NR) is an assignment status, not a robustness level.

source_definition: Identify root causes and impacts during post-incident analysis.
target_definition: Root grouping class for concepts required to represent the controlled SORA supplier-assurance domain.

source_definition: Apply physical, technical or cryptographic protections to data.
target_definition: A physical computing or UAS component.

source_definition: Maintain essential functions during disruption or incidents.
target_definition: A computer-based system relevant to business, maintenance, or UAS support activities.

source_definition: Manage personnel entry, role change or exit with security-relevant training and controls.
target_definition: A controlled vocabulary entry identifying the kind of activity required or performed, such as audit, test, validation, monitoring, maintenance, or training.

source_definition: A team assigned to incident response or recovery activities.
target_definition: A classified failure condition to which severity and frequency expectations can be assigned.

source_definition: Anticipate technological developments that could adversely affect essential systems.
target_definition: The configuration of the UAS or supporting systems that is subject to conformity and change control.

source_definition: The level and type of cyber risk the programme is prepared to accept and use in decision-making.
target_definition: A controlled type describing the state of an operation relevant to SORA risk, including loss of control.

source_definition: A specialist external or internal role that augments cyber incident recovery capability.
target_definition: A self-inspection, internal audit, or robust audit programme addressing cyber-safety/SORA concerns.

source_definition: A control selected, monitored, reviewed or resourced to manage cybersecurity risk.
target_definition: A station used to control or supervise the unmanned aircraft.

source_definition: A stakeholder role associated with use of the delivered capability.
target_definition: A documented procedure governing UAS maintenance or associated cyber-safety practices.

source_definition: Data while being transferred, including third-party transfers.
target_definition: Removable electronic media used in maintenance or data transfer.

source_definition: A mechanism intended to provide or strengthen cyber resilience and subject to testing or assessment.
target_definition: The volume within which the UAS operation is intended to take place safely.

source_definition: Dispose of assets or capabilities securely in accordance with required procedures and classification rules.
target_definition: A controlled manual describing information, procedures, or instructions.

source_definition: Direct and control cybersecurity decision-making across the programme.
target_definition: An industry-recognised cybersecurity accreditation.

source_definition: Relates a requirement or activity to the lifecycle context in which it applies.
target_definition: Links an OSO robustness assignment to the SAIL context in which it applies.

source_definition: Links an official SbD requirement to an analytical atomic requirement clause candidate derived from it.
target_definition: Links an analytical atomic obligation to the official SORA requirement from which it was decomposed.

source_definition: Associates a requirement, activity, risk or artefact with the role accountable or responsible for it.
target_definition: Associates a requirement, activity, or assurance claim with the SORA-domain object or concept it concerns.

source_definition: Associates an official SbD criterion with the SbD principle under which that criterion is defined.
target_definition: Links an OSO or criterion to an explicitly stated alternative criterion, such as a Functional Test-Based route.

source_definition: Links an SbD requirement to an actor, role, organisation, programme, group or other organisational concept involved in the requirement.
target_definition: Links an assurance artefact, procedure, programme, training artefact, mechanism, or claim to the actor role that validates it.

source_definition: Relates an activity to an information artefact, evidence item, record or assessment output that it generates.
target_definition: Links an actor to a document or information artefact that it creates, maintains, or supplies.

source_definition: Indicates that a process, control, activity, resource or managed object supports a function, decision, objective or other capability concern.
target_definition: Links an AssuranceClaim to evidence that supports the claim.

source_definition: Relates a testing or assurance activity to the plan, mechanism, backup, architecture, process or other subject being tested.
target_definition: Links an EvidenceArtifact to the type of assurance activity whose execution/result it evidences.

source_definition: Links an SbD requirement to a security property or objective that the requirement explicitly or inferentially seeks to protect or achieve.
target_definition: Links a SORA Assurance requirement to the Declaration form of assurance explicitly permitted by the source.

source_definition: Indicates that a security requirement or security-management element is included in a contract, specification, plan or procurement artefact.
target_definition: Classifies a requirement element as Annex E safety or Cyber Extension cyber-safety/security.

source_definition: Associates a stakeholder role with a stakeholder need or expectation relevant to the capability or programme.
target_definition: Associates a configuration, component, manufactured item, or other relevant object with its conformity status.
